div.head: IV Eg 1.5
div.ab: Ðonne beode ic minum gerefan, be minum freondscype ⁊ be eallum þam ðe hi ágon, þæt hi styran ælcum þara ðe þis ne gelæste ⁊ minra witena wed abrecan mid ænegum wacscype wille, swa swa him seo foresæde geradnes tæce; ⁊ on ðære steore ne sy nan forgyfnes.

Futher, I enjoin upon my reeves, on pain of forfeiting my friendship and all they possess, to deal in the manner prescribed by the aforesaid ordinance with everyone who fails to perform this, and by remissness on his part, consents to violate the solemn declaration of my councillors. And there shall be no remission of the [prescribed] punishment.

Þonne beode ic minum gerefan, be minum freondscipe ⁊ be eallum þam þe hy ágon, þæt hy styran ælcum þara þe þis ne gelæste ⁊ minra witena wed abrecan mid ænegum wacscipe wille, swa swa him seo foresæde geradnes tæce; ⁊ on þære steore ne sy nan forgifnes.
